title: Wave Amplitude and Tension
body: A sinusoidal wave travels down a taut, horizontal string with a linear mass density of $$\mu=0.060\, \tfrac{\text{kg}}{\text{m}}.$$ The maximum vertical speed of the wave is $$v_y=0.30\, \tfrac{\text{cm}}{\text{s}}.$$ The wave is modeled with the wave equation $$y(x,t)=A\sin(6.00x-24.00t),$$ with $$x$$ in meters and $$t$$ in seconds.
